## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/RebirthService.luau
purpose: Feature: Rebirth with a multiplier: once a player has bought every upgrade in the tree OR has at least 5000 cash, a glowing golden Rebirth altar on their plot (and a Rebirth button in the HUD) lets them rebirth. A RebirthService on the server validates the requirement (cost 5000 cash, doubling each rebirth), resets their Cash to 0 and their bought upgrades to none (rebuilding the plot's buy pads via UpgradeService), increments a Rebirths leaderstat, and gives a permanent cash multiplier of 1 + 0.5 * rebirths applied to every collected ore. The client shows a full-screen golden flash and 'REBIRTH x<mult>!' banner. Bump counters rebirths and rebirth_denied. -- Server-authoritative rebirth system, a ModuleScript required and initialised from Game.server. It creates the RemoteEvents in one place under ReplicatedStorage (RebirthRequest client->server, RebirthResult server->client carrying ok, new multiplier, next cost and a reason). Per player it keeps a rebirth count and creates an integer 'Rebirths' leaderstat in the existing leaderstats folder (wait for it with a timeout). It sets the player attribute 'RebirthMult' to multiplierFor(rebirths), which Tycoon reads, so there is no circular require. Exposes init(), onPlotClaimed(player, plot) and onPlotReleased(player), and tryRebirth(player). onPlotClaimed builds a glowing golden Neon altar part from code on the claimed plot, using the plot data fields that PlotBuilder and PlotClaimService already return and placed off the spawn and walking path. The altar has a billboard showing the cost and a ProximityPrompt that calls tryRebirth. onPlotReleased destroys the altar. tryRebirth applies a per-player cooldown and checks, in one step, eligible = UpgradeService.hasAll(player) or Cash >= cost. If not eligible it fires RebirthResult with ok=false and counts 'rebirth_denied'. If eligible it sets Cash to 0, calls UpgradeService.resetPlayer(player) to clear purchases and rebuild the pads, increments the rebirth count and the Rebirths leaderstat, updates the RebirthMult attribute and the altar billboard, fires RebirthResult with ok=true, and counts 'rebirths'. The RebirthRequest handler only calls tryRebirth and trusts nothing from the client. Players already in the game at startup are handled by looping Players:GetPlayers() and also connecting PlayerAdded. Bumps counters rebirths and rebirth_denied, each in this module only. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: rebirths, rebirth_denied.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/RebirthConfig.luau, ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau, ServerScriptService/UpgradeService.luau

```luau
--!strict
-- RebirthConfig: shared tunables and pure helpers for the Rebirth feature (server and client).

local RebirthConfig = {
	baseCost = 5000,
	costGrowth = 2,
	multPerRebirth = 0.5,
	requestCooldown = 1.5, -- seconds between rebirth requests per player
	altarColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	altarGlowColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 150),
	altarSize = Vector3.new(4, 5, 4),
	flashDuration = 1.2, -- seconds for the full-screen golden flash
	bannerDuration = 2.5, -- seconds the 'REBIRTH x<mult>!' banner stays up
	flashColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60),
}

-- Cash required for the next rebirth, given how many rebirths were already done.
function RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return math.floor(RebirthConfig.baseCost * RebirthConfig.costGrowth ^ n)
end

-- Permanent cash multiplier for a given number of rebirths.
function RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return 1 + RebirthConfig.multPerRebirth * n
end

-- Formats a multiplier for display, e.g. 1.5 -> "1.5", 2 -> "2.0".
function RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(mult: number): string
	return string.format("%.1f", mult)
end

-- Banner text, e.g. "REBIRTH x1.5!".
function RebirthConfig.bannerText(rebirths: number): string
	return "REBIRTH x" .. RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths)) .. "!"
end

-- Rounded payout for a cube value after applying the multiplier.
function RebirthConfig.applyMultiplier(value: number, rebirths: number): number
	return math.floor(value * RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths) + 0.5)
end

-- Whether a player may rebirth: enough cash, or every upgrade bought.
function RebirthConfig.canRebirth(cash: number, rebirths: number, allUpgradesBought: boolean): boolean
	return allUpgradesBought or cash >= RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths)
end

return RebirthConfig
```

### ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

```luau
-- PriceBillboard: world price tag over a buy pad / shop item; green when affordable, red when not. Server or client.
-- Standalone (no Theme needed) so a server Script can paste it too.
local function priceBillboard(part: BasePart, title: string, price: number): (BillboardGui, (boolean) -> ())
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size, bb.StudsOffset = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.LightInfluence = false, 80, 0
	bb.Adornee = part
	local function text(t: string, y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, h), UDim2.fromScale(0, y), 1
		l.Text, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = t, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, true, color
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Thickness, s.Color = 3, Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
		s.Parent = l
		l.Parent = bb
		return l
	end
	text(title, 0, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
	local cost = text("$" .. tostring(price), 0.45, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64))
	bb.Parent = part
	local function setAffordable(ok: boolean)
		cost.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) else Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
	end
	return bb, setAffordable -- client: call setAffordable(cash.Value >= price) on cash.Changed
end
```

```luau
-- RebirthService: server-authoritative rebirth system (altar, remotes, multiplier, leaderstat).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local RebirthConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local UpgradeService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("UpgradeService"))

local RebirthService = {}

type State = {
	rebirths: number,
	last: number,
	altar: BasePart?,
	label: TextLabel?,
	stat: IntValue?,
}

local states: { [Player]: State } = {}
local requestRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local resultRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local started = false

local function getRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = name
	r.Parent = folder
	return r
end

local function getCash(player: Player): IntValue?
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not ls then
		return nil
	end
	local c = ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if c and (c:IsA("IntValue") or c:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return c :: any
	end
	return nil
end

local function ensureState(player: Player): State
	local s = states[player]
	if not s then
		s = { rebirths = 0, last = 0, altar = nil, label = nil, stat = nil }
		states[player] = s
		player:SetAttribute("RebirthMult", RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(0))
	end
	return s
end

local function updateLabel(s: State)
	if s.label then
		s.label.Text = "REBIRTH\n$" .. tostring(RebirthConfig.costFor(s.rebirths))
			.. "\nNext: x" .. RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(s.rebirths + 1))
	end
end

local function fireResult(player: Player, ok: boolean, s: State, reason: string)
	if resultRemote then
		resultRemote:FireClient(player, ok, RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(s.rebirths), RebirthConfig.costFor(s.rebirths), reason)
	end
end

function RebirthService.tryRebirth(player: Player)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local s = ensureState(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - s.last < RebirthConfig.requestCooldown then
		return
	end
	s.last = now

	local cash = getCash(player)
	local cost = RebirthConfig.costFor(s.rebirths)
	local hasAll = false
	if type(UpgradeService.hasAll) == "function" then
		local okCall, res = pcall(UpgradeService.hasAll, player)
		hasAll = okCall and res == true
	end
	local eligible = hasAll or (cash ~= nil and cash.Value >= cost)
	if not eligible or cash == nil then
		fireResult(player, false, s, "Need $" .. tostring(cost) .. " or every upgrade")
		ForgeTelemetry.count("rebirth_denied", 1)
		return
	end

	cash.Value = 0
	if type(UpgradeService.resetPlayer) == "function" then
		local okReset, err = pcall(UpgradeService.resetPlayer, player)
		if not okReset then
			warn("RebirthService: resetPlayer failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	s.rebirths += 1
	if s.stat then
		s.stat.Value = s.rebirths
	end
	player:SetAttribute("RebirthMult", RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(s.rebirths))
	updateLabel(s)
	fireResult(player, true, s, "ok")
	ForgeTelemetry.count("rebirths", 1)
end

function RebirthService.onPlotClaimed(player: Player, plot: any)
	local s = ensureState(player)
	if s.altar then
		s.altar:Destroy()
		s.altar, s.label = nil, nil
	end
	if type(plot) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local origin = plot.origin
	local cf: CFrame
	if typeof(origin) == "CFrame" then
		cf = origin
	elseif typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
		cf = CFrame.new(origin)
	else
		return
	end
	local size = RebirthConfig.altarSize
	local altar = Instance.new("Part")
	altar.Name = "RebirthAltar_" .. player.Name
	altar.Size = size
	altar.Anchored = true
	altar.CanCollide = true
	altar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	altar.Color = RebirthConfig.altarColor
	altar.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-16, size.Y / 2, 16)

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = RebirthConfig.altarGlowColor
	light.Range = 18
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = altar

	local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(RebirthConfig.altarGlowColor)
	sparks.Rate = 8
	sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
	sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
	sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.4, 0)
	sparks.LightEmission = 1
	sparks.Parent = altar

	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(7, 4)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
	bb.MaxDistance = 90
	bb.Adornee = altar
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = RebirthConfig.altarGlowColor
	label.Text = ""
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
	stroke.Parent = label
	label.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = altar

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Rebirth"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Golden Altar"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who: Player)
		if who == player then
			RebirthService.tryRebirth(player)
		end
	end)
	prompt.Parent = altar

	s.altar, s.label = altar, label
	updateLabel(s)
	altar.Parent = Workspace
end

function RebirthService.onPlotReleased(player: Player)
	local s = states[player]
	if s and s.altar then
		s.altar:Destroy()
		s.altar, s.label = nil, nil
	end
end

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	local s = ensureState(player)
	task.spawn(function()
		local ls = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)
		if not ls then
			local f = Instance.new("Folder")
			f.Name = "leaderstats"
			f.Parent = player
			ls = f
		end
		if player.Parent ~= Players or s.stat then
			return
		end
		local stat = ls:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
		if not (stat and stat:IsA("IntValue")) then
			stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
			stat.Name = "Rebirths"
			stat.Value = s.rebirths
			stat.Parent = ls
		end
		s.stat = stat :: IntValue
	end)
end

local function removePlayer(player: Player)
	RebirthService.onPlotReleased(player)
	states[player] = nil
end

function RebirthService.init()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Remotes"
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	requestRemote = getRemote(folder, "RebirthRequest")
	resultRemote = getRemote(folder, "RebirthResult")
	if requestRemote then
		requestRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player)
			RebirthService.tryRebirth(player)
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removePlayer)
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		setupPlayer(p)
	end
end

return RebirthService
```
